cells.tense: You are carrying what you carry and laying it down where the need is, with the pen.
cells.ask: For a month, keep one standing arrangement exactly as it is, and each week name one thing you are not adding to that day.
cells.core:
You put strength where it is needed and you know how much is enough. That takes sense, not force, and from where you stand you can see who is carrying too much before anyone has to tell you. The pattern usually arrives whole, all at once, and you move.

It holds while you keep stopping. Even a body trained for a long time reaches a point where straining breaks it rather than holds it, and you can feel that line. What you have built needs your pull now, not more of your pushing, and the cultivating that earned this is already done. Make the adding a choice instead of a reflex, and let what is already working be enough for a while. The arrangement you keep unguarded is the one that shows you whether it is.
cells.sheetLine: You share your strength by measure now, and you know the measure.
cells.verb: moving your strength outward to whoever is holding more than they can carry
cells.place: standing inside the whole and seeing it at once

cells.tense: You are already holding the next thing that has not been handed to you, ahead of anyone asking.
cells.ask: Name one load you are not obligated to hold, and drop the first task you took on for it today, before anyone agrees.
cells.core:
You are already braced under what has not been handed to you. Before it is asked for, before it is yours, you have sized the weight, taken your position, and made the offer. And you can see the whole pattern from here, so every gap looks like a place your strength is needed, and you get there before the need does.

The size is not the issue; the timing is. Holding can hold without forcing, and yours is forcing. The fairness you can feel has not been checked against anyone. Test one gap before you lift. Ask whether the person on the other side is standing already. Say no to one thing today and watch what happens without stepping back in. That is not coldness. Carrying what no one needed carried is how the thing that did need you goes uncovered.
cells.sheetLine: You lift before the ask arrives, and you call it being needed.

cells.tense: You saw what was needed and stayed at the door where the asking used to go wrong, and you are still standing there.
cells.ask: Pick one arrangement you already see and set one definite condition on it this week — the day, the amount, the end. Then hold that one.
cells.core:
You can see the whole thing. You can point to the exact place the weight sits and who is bending under it, right now, while you talk. What is missing is the movement between seeing and doing. Your strength stays home while the picture stays clear in front of you.

Being able to see it is not the problem, and it was not a failure. The step is small: make one arrangement you already see definite, with a condition on it. Not a bigger heart, not a wider door. An arrangement with an end sends a stream back through the watching. When something you set is finished, you can lay it down instead of gripping it, and what you notice has somewhere to go again.
cells.sheetLine: You see where the strength is needed and you are not moving it.
cells.verb: moving your strength outward to whoever is holding more than they can carry

cells.tense: You are holding people up right now and calling it being able to help when someone asks.
cells.ask: Pick one thing you are already carrying for someone this week and say out loud why you kept doing it this way.
cells.core:
You are already the one, in this. People come to you and something clears. The strength is moving outward and it is doing its work, and you describe it as a convenience, the capable one, no big deal. Where you are standing, the whole pattern is visible, so you keep agreeing to be the fixed point for it without ever saying that you chose it.

So the strength that helps most is the one you admit to. Pick one thing you are already carrying for someone and tell them what you are going by, why this, why this long. Not a confession, one sentence at a time, in your own plain words. Once you name who decided, the same effort stops feeling like something that happens to you and starts feeling like yours, and it will not be the last one.
cells.sheetLine: You are already the one holding this. You are calling it nothing.
cells.verb: moving your strength outward to whoever is holding more than they can carry
cells.place: standing inside the whole and seeing it at once
